classes.intro: Expert marksmen with unparalleled bow and crossbow mastery.

perks.name: Steady Draw
perks.description: -15% stamina drain while drawing

perks.name: Arrow Slinger
perks.description: Arrows give a buff on hit that reduces draw time by 50% for 10 seconds

perks.name: Wind Reader
perks.description: +15% damage beyond 25m; -25% stamina while aiming

perks.name: Magic Shot
perks.description: 50% chance to not consume an arrow on attack

perks.name: Adrenaline Rush
perks.description: Consecutive hits return 5% stamina

classes.outro: Perfect for players who enjoy ranged combat and precision shooting.

classes.intro: Stealthy fighters who strike from the shadows with deadly precision.

perks.name: Cutthroat
perks.description: +15% knife damage; +30% backstab multiplier

perks.name: Venom Coating
perks.description: Knife hits apply stacking Poison (up to 3 stacks) based on skill level

perks.name: Envenomous
perks.description: Poisons apply 15% movement speed slow per stack

perks.name: Assassination
perks.description: First knife hit from stealth deals +100% damage

perks.name: Twist the Knife
perks.description: +25% damage to poisoned targets; poisoned enemies deal -10% damage

classes.outro: Great for players who prefer tactical, stealthy gameplay and damage over time.

classes.intro: Bare-knuckle brawlers with unmatched unarmed combat skills.

perks.name: One-Two Combo
perks.description: Every 3rd consecutive punch deals +100% damage and restores 5% stamina

perks.name: Break Guard
perks.description: Fist attacks deal +50% stagger damage

perks.name: Iron Fist
perks.description: Fist attacks deal extra damage equal to 10% max health; +20% attack speed

perks.name: Tough
perks.description: When not wearing chest piece, gain +25% physical damage resistance

perks.name: Rage
perks.description: After unblocked damage, enter 5s rage: +50% attack speed, +50% damage resist, +25% fist damage (15s cooldown)

classes.outro: For players who want to fight with their fists like a true Viking warrior.

classes.intro: Defensive specialists who excel at protection and shield mastery.

perks.name: Shield Wall
perks.description: +15% Block Power; -15% block stamina cost.

perks.name: Perfect Guard
perks.description: Blocked attacks restore 5 stamina. Reduce Block Stamina consumption by 50%.

perks.name: Towering Presence
perks.description: Tower shields gain an additional +25% Block Power.

perks.name: Thorns
perks.description:
Blocked attacks return 50% of the original damage back to the attacker.

This damage deals increased stagger damage (20%).

perks.name: Reverb!
perks.description: After blocking 200 damage, release shockwave dealing 200 blunt damage in 5m (10s cooldown).

classes.outro: Best for players who want to be the party's shield and ultimate protector.

classes.intro: Powerful warriors who excel with heavy blunt weapons.

perks.name: Bonebreaker
perks.description: +15% blunt damage; +25% stagger power

perks.name: Cold Steel
perks.description: Melee attacks imbued with frost dealing +20% weapon damage as frost

perks.name: Thundering Blows
perks.description: Heavy melee attacks generate 2m shockwave of lightning damage

perks.name: Might of the Earth
perks.description: -30% stamina drain on attacks from wielding heavy weapons

perks.name: Colossus
perks.description: Ignore movement speed penalties from armor weight

classes.outro: Best suited for players who like devastating area attacks and crowd control.

classes.intro: Spear specialists with superior reach and polearm technique.

perks.name: Reach Advantage
perks.description: +15% pierce damage; -15% stamina cost when attacking.

perks.name: Spear Storm
perks.description: Successful hits apply a stacking buff. Each stack causes your attacks to deal 5% additional damage as lightning damage for 5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times, stacks refresh on hit.

perks.name: Disruptive Strikes
perks.description: Hits have a 50% chance to disable the targets movement.

perks.name: Impressive Throw
perks.description: Damage increases the further the target is away from you. Up to 300% for 100 meters away.

perks.name: Spear Of Relocation
perks.description: When a thrown spear connects with an enemy you teleport to that enemy.

classes.outro: Perfect for players who like versatile polearm combat and tactical positioning.

classes.intro: Masters of blade combat with exceptional swordsmanship skills.

perks.name: Riposte Training
perks.description: +10% sword damage. After you parry, next sword hit within 2s deals +25% damage

perks.name: Dancing Steel
perks.description: 15% increased attack speed with swords

perks.name: Fencer's Footwork
perks.description: -15% sword stamina cost; +10% movement speed for 3s after hits

perks.name: Weakpoint Cut
perks.description: +15% armor penetration; +25% stagger vs. humanoids/undead

perks.name: Counter Attacker
perks.description: +50% Parry Bonus, +40 Block Power with all swords

classes.outro: Ideal for players who prefer melee combat with finesse and precision.

classes.intro: Mystical practitioners of elemental magic and arcane arts.

perks.name: Eitr Weave
perks.description: +50% Eitr regeneration.

perks.name: Icy Hot
perks.description: +25% Fire and Frost damage.

perks.name: Essence Leech
perks.description: Gain Eitr equal to 5% of damage dealt from Magical Attacks.

perks.name: Frost Armor
perks.description: Dealing 300 frost damage triggers Frost Armor (30s): +25% armor, fire immunity.

perks.name: Immolation Aura
perks.description: Dealing 500 fire damage triggers Immolation Aura (30s): +25% speed, 15 fire DPS to nearby enemies

classes.outro: Ideal for players who want to master Valheim's magic system and elemental combat.
